place.name: Casa Bonita
place.description: Casa Bonita (lit. 'pretty house' in Spanish) is a Mexican restaurant in Lakewood, Colorado, located within the Lamar Station Plaza. It first opened in 1974 and was originally part of a chain of Mexican entertainment restaurants that started in Oklahoma City.
